title: Christmas Dinosaurs Bold & Easy Coloring Book for Kids
subtitle: 50 Big, Simple Dino Pictures with Santa Hats, Presents & Snowmen for Toddlers & Kids Ages 3-6
author: Crayon Cove Press
description_html:
Friendly dinosaurs get ready for Christmas in 50 big, simple pictures!

Bold and easy designs with thick outlines and large spaces: perfect first coloring for toddlers and preschoolers.

  • 50 pictures, each on its own page with a blank back (no marker bleed-through)
  • Thick, bold lines and one big subject per page, easy for little hands
  • T-Rex decorating the tree, a dino pulling the sleigh, presents, stockings, gingerbread, snowmen, candy canes, sledding and cookie baking
  • Cute, friendly, original dinosaurs in Santa hats, elf hats and scarves
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A fun stocking stuffer or Christmas gift for dinosaur-loving kids ages 3-6.
